description: This file implements a set of functions for managing a collection of object IDs ('oidset'), including initialization, insertion, removal, comparison, parsing from a file, and other set operations. It appears to be used within a Git-related project for handling object identifiers.

methods.name: void oidset_init(struct oidset * set,size_t initial_size)
methods.description: Initializes an oidset, optionally resizing it to an initial size.

methods.name: int oidset_contains(const struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks whether a given object_id is present in the oidset.

methods.name: bool oidset_equal(const struct oidset * a,const struct oidset * b)
methods.description: Checks whether two oidsets are equal based on their contents.

methods.name: int oidset_insert(struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Inserts an object_id into the oidset.

methods.name: void oidset_insert_from_set(struct oidset * dest,struct oidset * src)
methods.description: Inserts all object_ids from a source set into a destination set.

methods.name: int oidset_remove(struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Removes an object_id from the set.

methods.name: void oidset_clear(struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Clears all entries from the set.

methods.name: void oidset_parse_file(struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses object IDs from a file into the set.

methods.name: void oidset_parse_file_carefully(struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop,oidset_parse_tweak_fn fn,void * cbdata)
methods.description: Safely parses object IDs from a file with additional processing options.
